<!-- ADHA Baniyas. The app is 100dvh and owns the whole screen; nothing here scrolls at page level.
     Without this the page is 24px taller than the viewport, so a strip of the white html canvas
     shows under the map and the explore panel on a phone. The 24px is an empty line box: Experience
     Cloud renders a row of zero-height utility components after the page content - hidden-region,
     viewchange-notifier, the data-layer objects, the dirty-state listener, the session validator -
     and being inline-level they generate a line box even at zero height. display:none on them also
     removes it, but two are functional and the session validator is not worth 24px. -->
<style>
  html, body { overflow: hidden; height: 100%; }
</style>
